items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: For instance, Leroy Jones said you've been around.

ctx.x: Well, what about the avant garde. You touched on it a little bit with Archie Shepp and the people like Leroy Jones has written books and you span the entire spectrum in a sense, when they talk about you. For instance, Leroy Jones said you've been around. You're the prime innovator, but you've been around so long, people have had a chance to pick up. So when they talk about you, they talk about really the entire history of black music, black sophisticated music, on the level we're talking about. So how do you feel…

Well, personally, avantgarde, like they say, is outside, you know. For a while, I believed that they did that to keep what they said cats was stealing their music. It was that black-white thing again. So they said they going to play something that they won't be able to steal, which was a lie, and if you notice now, the avantgarde is actually Euro-
